snippet.title: F-Zero Final v0.2 Available Now!
snippet.description:
F-Zero Final v0.2 is ready to go and you know what that means:

8 Vehicles!
20 Tracks!
Unlocked Practice Mode!
And much much more

Download the code and start playing here: https://github.com/originalgrego/FZeroFinal

The Ultra Net team will be streaming the new build of F-Zero Final and it's companion mod F-Zero Final VS September 15, 2018!

Tune in to our stream at:

https://www.twitch.tv/ultranetsnes

For more information on F-Zero Final please check out our RHDN post:

http://www.romhacking.net/forum/index.php?topic=26750.0

Or visit us at F-Zero Online on Discord:

https://discord.gg/KAECQb8
